dimensions.interactionSequence: Across three rounds, each active player chooses among surfaced attacks, targets, and legal routes. The Goblin Warrior protects its Wolf-facing line, the Skeleton protects against the Goblin Warrior while advancing on the Horse, the Wolf selects a southern-pillar side and can redirect to the Goblin Warrior, and the Horse can redirect from the Wolf to the Skeleton. Recent attacks, start-of-turn distances, post-movement attackability, and pillar geometry can change the priority before a surfaced movement reaction or interrupt is resolved; every turn ends through End Turn. This differs from the fixed one-turn crank sequence, the open two-creature tracer, the Hawk out-and-back traversal, mounted cylinder and dismount branches, the fixed Wolf/Skeleton lane pursuit, the Character Sheet prism and beacon sequences, the sand skirmish, the forced Prone attacks, the fixed Shove/Grapple and three-Shove sequences, the single first-Bite circumstance test, and the portcullis escape sequence.
